items.title: LEANGUARD: Lean-Verified Guardrails for Tool-Using Agents
items.summary: LeanGuard is a verified runtime that blocks policy-violating tool calls by language-model agents and can repair them via proof-guided search, reducing unauthorized executions and prompt-injection success without harming benign task performance.

items.title: Multi-Agent Relay Thinking
items.summary: MACR introduces a relay-based multi-agent framework that dynamically transfers reasoning between agents using confidence-guided triggering and bidding to improve accuracy with lower token overhead.

items.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
items.summary: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.

items.title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
items.summary: Tutorial Agentic Learning enables LLM agents to continuously learn from instructional videos without parameter updates by building a structured tutorialbook memory and retrieving via reasoning-linked table-of-contents trees.

items.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.summary: Empirical study shows continual harness self-evolution across software engineering tasks causes severe catastrophic forgetting, with performance on earlier datasets dropping sharply after later evolution.

items.title: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
items.summary: The Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark evaluates AI agents as teammates across 240 tasks, revealing that even top models have significant collaboration weaknesses unrelated to individual capability.

items.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
items.summary: This report proposes a unified taxonomy and literature system for agentic computer graphics driven by large language models, analyzing trends and open challenges in human-agent collaboration and long-horizon planning.

items.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
items.summary: CoworkOS is a long-horizon agent harness that separates strategy from execution, supports human-in-the-loop collaboration via shared artifacts, and improves model performance through sustained automated post-training.

items.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.summary: CUA-Master uses nested recursive loops with open-world data and feedback-driven retries to continuously improve computer-use agents across diverse benchmarks.

items.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
items.summary: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.

items.title: SIMIT: Self-Improving Vision-Language Models via Imagination at Test-Time
items.summary: SIMIT is a test-time framework that lets vision-language models generate their own practice data to improve answers on unlabeled queries without external annotations.

items.title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
items.summary: WorldFlow is a generative world model that jointly predicts future video and 3D trajectories using continuous displacement tokens and a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone, improving physical dynamics prediction across diverse benchmarks.

items.title: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
items.summary: CrossSWE introduces a multi-repository benchmark showing that current LLMs struggle with cross-repository consistency during joint software development.

items.title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
items.summary: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency: enabling people to pursue their goals with less routine supervision while retaining control over consequential decisions. We advocate Avatar Intelligence, a paradigm of persistent personal agents that represent users' goals, values, and constraints through sustained decision delegation across contexts and time. We describe a maturity roadmap from human-directed execution to autonomous operation within delegated domains, and introduce the Agentic Oversight Index (AOI) as a framework for evaluating delivered value against agent-side operational cost and human oversight burden. We identify three core research challenges: identity-continuous personalization that carries user preferences across tasks, user-situated evolution through Rehearsal Engineering, and safety mechanisms that combine technical control with accountability and recourse. These directions define a research agenda for reliable decision delegation to personal agents across tasks and over time.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.summary: NorthCUA scales computer-use agents via an experience flywheel, recursive self-improvement, staged learning, and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art open-source GUI and web interaction results.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Agent harnesses integrate video generation and world models to enable planning, tool use, and recursive self-improvement for autonomous multi-shot video production.

items.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
items.summary: Frontier AI research agents propose many sound experiments but show limited ability to rank them better than simple baselines, with teams offering no clear quality gains.

items.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
items.summary: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes complex, interdependent software development tasks with verified tests to train coding agents, improving performance on long-horizon benchmarks.

items.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
items.summary: ReTrace is a framework that evaluates recovery behavior in computer-use agents by formalizing transition-consistent recovery and demonstrating that autonomous model-based recovery improves long-horizon reliability.

items.title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
items.summary: Vision-language models often judge 3D object properties correctly but fail to recover and consistently apply exact per-color counts, motivating evaluation by exact correctness, consistency, and visual dependence.

items.title: BYOD: Build Your Own DLM - Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Model Conversion
items.summary: BYOD converts autoregressive language models into diffusion models via parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, enabling parallel generation with minimal training cost while preserving base-model knowledge.

items.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
items.summary: Library of Layers dynamically orders transformer blocks during inference to adapt computation to tasks, enabling parameter reuse, sparsity, and interpretable routing across reasoning, multilingual, and safety settings.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.summary: TinyAstral improves robot agent harnesses via recursive self-improvement and distills compact students that retain performance gains with lower compute.

items.title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
items.summary: MAServeBench evaluates LLM serving and hardware by modeling multi-agent collaboration as a configurable workload dimension with reproducible dependency traces.

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.summary: GEPA-Curator improves agentic prompt optimization by filtering unreliable failure signals and retrieving past successes, boosting performance across multiple benchmarks.

items.title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
items.summary: Jev's cross-primitive consistency is benchmarked and improved via a residual calibrator that reduces inconsistency and boosts decision accuracy.

items.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
items.summary: The study evaluates frozen video representations to show that prediction errors reflect appearance and motion rather than reliably measuring physical surprise.

items.title: Lab2Sim: Turning Real-World Experiment Videos into Interactive Virtual Experiments
items.summary: Lab2Sim introduces a benchmark for converting science videos into interactive virtual experiments, and EduVideo2Code improves apparatus fidelity by encoding procedures as state machines for verified code generation.

items.title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
items.summary: FLAMIA accelerates Transformer attention on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs via MXFP8 and mixed-precision kernels that reduce quantization overhead, prevent causal leakage, and support variable-length packed documents.

items.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary: Multimodal language models fail at multi-step visual reasoning due to a reference gap rather than perception, and task-matched external references like numbering significantly improve accuracy without training.

items.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.summary: Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation improves on-policy self-distillation by continuously enhancing self-teaching reliability through reward-guided teacher optimization and adaptive down-weighting of unreliable samples.

items.title: DeFT-RAG: Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
items.summary: DeFT-RAG improves multi-hop question answering by generating self-contained sub-questions sequentially, offloading reasoning to rule-based updates and a lightweight decision model, and caching answers to reduce LLM usage.

items.title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
items.summary: TSFLab is a self-improving agent-agnostic workbench that equips coding agents with shared resources to reduce costs and automate maintenance for time series forecasting research and benchmarking.

items.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
items.summary: SimpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.

items.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
items.summary: OSWAM enables real-time, high-quality action generation in autonomous driving and embodied control by initializing diffusion with structured imagination tokens and distilling future-conditioned privileged information into a single denoising step.

items.title: When Morphs Look Better: Face Image Quality as a Training-Free Signal for Morphing Attack Detection
items.summary: Face image quality assessment methods vary widely in detecting diffusion-based and other morphing attacks, with performance depending heavily on attack type and dataset, and high quality scores for morphs often indicate poor detection.

items.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
items.summary: Reviso is an agentic video captioning framework that learns to prioritize key visual evidence through hierarchical planning and active perception, improving caption quality and downstream video understanding.

items.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
items.summary: Wave Forcing enables efficient continuous long-video generation with consistent appearance and natural motion through co-designed generation, training, and execution, achieving high throughput and quality.

items.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
items.summary: Embedding research across modalities is converging toward shared principles via contrastive learning and Transformers, and a framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality is proposed to unify it through transformation, alignment, and joint embedding.

items.title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
items.summary: Auxiliary trajectory preferences based on entropy and confidence metrics improve small language model self-improvement and transfer by distinguishing learning value among equally correct reasoning traces.

items.title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
items.summary: ProVe reverses speculative decoding roles by fine-tuning a large model to propose token blocks and verifying them with a smaller or identical model, achieving faster autoregressive generation with adjustable speed-accuracy tradeoffs.

items.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
items.summary: SOMA is a benchmark assessing fine-grained egocentric body-motion reasoning in multimodal models, revealing substantial gaps versus human performance and providing training data and a multimodal baseline to advance the field.

items.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
items.summary: Metis-1.6 introduces small, efficient mixture-of-experts language models trained with limited data that achieve competitive math performance and Pareto-optimal efficiency despite training errors and architectural issues.

items.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
items.summary: Quality-Controllable Policy enables real-time adjustment of robot execution quality and improves performance through iterative hindsight relabeling of online rollouts.

items.title: TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
items.summary: An audio-guided framework restores facial details in AI-generated videos by combining reference-guided flow modeling with audio synchronization to resolve lip and dental ambiguity.

items.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
items.summary: PhotoGuider selects viewing directions and frames 360° panoramas using shared composition-aware tokens and produces camera-parameter outputs with explanation-conditioned scoring.

items.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.summary: DecisionRank uses item-space on-policy distillation to transfer ranking knowledge from generative teachers to efficient decision models, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval performance with significantly faster inference.

items.title: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
items.summary: AuditFL is a blockchain-backed clearing layer that makes federated learning rounds auditable and economically constrained without removing the aggregator, preserving model accuracy under failures.

items.title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
items.summary: Visible-State Supervision and Test-Time Causal View Search improve streaming action recognition by separating representation learning from evidence selection, boosting accuracy with fewer frames.

items.title: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
items.summary: TurnTurk-GPT, a Turkish turn-taking predictor fine-tuned from GPT-2, outperforms multilingual detectors and reveals that Turkish end-of-turn cues rely on verb-final morphology.
